content:
Ravi Menon: Follow-up from last night's partial outage: cloud LB flapped when model-registry started returning 502s after auth provider throttled refreshes. Need clear owners and a short remediation plan.
Elena Garcia: Primary chain was short-lived tokens causing refresh storms -> vendor 429 -> our retries amplified load -> registry 502s.
Tom Wu: Hotfix ideas: increase token cache TTL 45s->240s, add refresh jitter, and add client-side per-identity serialization. Low risk, config-only.
Priya Rao: I'll own runbook + alerts. Proposed alert: `auth.refresh_concurrency > 30 for 5m`.
Ravi Menon: Proposed owners/timeline: Hotfix (24h): Tom (config + dedupe) + Priya (tests); Short-term (2w): Elena (dashboards + top-refreshers query), Ravi (vendor escalation + temp throttle request); Long-term (8w): infra (circuit breaker + signed tokens eval).
Tom Wu: Pushing canary config now: `token_cache_ttl=240, refresh_jitter=200-800ms, dedupe_window=3s`.
incidents-bot: Task created: "Auth refresh hotfix" assigned Tom Wu, Priya Rao. Due 24h.
Elena Garcia: I'll add a Datadog dashboard panel and a monitor for top subjects by refresh rate.
Priya Rao: Tests: simulate 300 clients refreshing in 10s in staging and verify vendor 429s do not cascade. I'll run tomorrow 09:00 PT.
Ravi Menon: Vendor ask: request logs and a temporary throttle lift for 72h; I'll own that. If no response in 48h, escalate to partner ops.
Tom Wu: Note: revocation risk if TTL longer. I'll wire a revocation webhook to invalidate caches (48h).
Ravi Menon: Action recap: Tom push hotfix (24h) + revocation hook (48h); Priya test harness + runbook (48h); Elena dashboards + alert (7-10d); Ravi vendor + escalation (48-72h). We'll reconvene after canary.
Priya Rao: ACK, will post results and any blockers in this thread. :thumbsup:
